[[File:Imperialball.png|thumb|The Emperor and Mara Jade at a possible occurrence of the Ball.]]The '''Imperial Ball''' was a grand monthly gathering of all [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] dignitaries and supporters that was held in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. It was presumably held at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|the Emperor]] themselves attended the ball if they could.
